item: 1 Enclosure body with membrane vent and lugs
spec: Light grey polycarbonate, 150 x 90 x 200 mm outside (W x D x H), IP65 or better, UV stabilized; four moulded bosses on the inside of the back wall for a mounting plate; the maker's kit of four external wall-mounting lugs; M12 ePTFE pressure-equalizing vent on the bottom face
supplier: Electrical enclosure maker (for example Fibox, Hammond or Bud class) via an electronics or electrical distributor; vent from an industrial vent maker
notes: Indicative price including vent and lug kit; size per cad/src/model.py; bottom face drilled for 6 penetrations in two rows (FND-DDR-003)

spec: Gasketed lid with captive stainless screws
M16 x 1.5 nylon gland, IP68, 4 to 8 mm cable; one for the panel lead, one for a fixed-cable sensor (blanking plug in item 13 when unused)
notes: Indicative price; TRL 2 had one gland blanked but the panel lead needs its own (FND-CAL-001)

spec: 6 W monocrystalline, 9 V class (Vmp about 9 V at 25 C), about 290 x 200 x 17 mm, with 1 m lead
notes: Indicative price; 9 V class per FND-DDR-002 (keeps about 7.4 V when hot); charger minimum input to confirm at TRL 4

spec: Two sides, each: one plate clip (aluminium angle 30 x 30 x 3 mm, 77 mm long), one post (flat bar 20 x 3 mm, 181 mm), one strut (flat bar 20 x 3 mm, 149 mm) and two panel clips (angle 30 x 30 x 3 mm, 30 mm long) on the panel frame's back lip; M6 bolts at the post foot (2), post head, strut foot and strut head; tilt set by hole position
supplier: Local make from metal stockist bar
notes: Indicative material cost; 6063 class aluminium; redesigned for construction (FND-DDR-003)

spec: 32700 LiFePO4, 3.2 V, 6 Ah (about 19 Wh), charge 0 to 45 C; holder with inline 5 A fuse, 10 k NTC and plug-in lead
supplier: Battery distributor (cell from a maker that publishes a datasheet)

spec: 1S LiFePO4 MPPT-style charger (bq24650 or LT3652 class) set to 3.6 V with NTC lockout; protection IC; fuel gauge; switched 3.3 V, 5 V and 12 V rails; serial programming header (1 x 6 straight pins at 2.54 mm: ground, 3.3 V, TX, RX, boot, reset) on the front face, wired to the controller and facing the lid so a 3.3 V USB-to-serial cable plugs in with the lid open
supplier: Custom carrier; ICs and header from an electronics distributor (DigiKey or Mouser class)
notes: Indicative prototype cost: USD 22.00 carrier as before plus USD 0.50 for the pin header (distributor price class at quantity 1); header added by FND-DEC-001 (2026-10-02, firmware update by cable); board design is TRL 4 work and not started

spec: STM32WL-class LoRaWAN module (RAK3172 or Wio-E5) on a carrier with 16 MB SPI flash and status LED
supplier: RAKwireless or Seeed Studio via their stores or an electronics distributor

spec: 915 MHz whip for the US915 first variant, about 2 dBi, about 190 mm, with bulkhead and pigtail
notes: Indicative price (unchanged); US915 default first variant (FND-DEC-001; DDR-001 O1); a whip for EU868 or another band replaces it only if the first adopting site is outside North America

spec: M12 5-pin A-coded panel-mount socket, IP67, with sealing cap
notes: Indicative price; wired to the proposed standard pinout (FND-DEC-001; DDR-001 O2)

spec: 3 mm printed ASA plate, 130 x 180 mm, lifts out with cell and boards
notes: Indicative material and print cost; ASA chosen over aluminium for mass (FND-CAL-001 section F)

spec: Aluminium back plate 180 x 320 x 3 mm with a 100 x 150 mm window behind the enclosure, band slots and fixing holes; two aluminium V-blocks 60 x 33 x 20 mm with a 90 deg V, each on two M4 countersunk screws; two 12 mm stainless worm-drive band clamps for 40 to 60 mm poles (about 230 to 280 mm band); wall screws and plugs
notes: Indicative price; V-blocks cut from 60 x 40 mm aluminium flat bar (FND-DDR-003)

spec: Stainless fixings: 10 x M6 x 16 hex bolts with nyloc nuts (bracket), 8 x M5 x 12 button-head screws with nyloc nuts (lugs and plate clips), 8 x M4 x 12 pan-head screws with nuts (panel clips), 4 x M4 x 12 countersunk screws (V-blocks), 4 x M4 x 10 screws (internal plate); nylon standoffs, hook-up wire, ferrules, M16 blanking plug, desiccant pack, cable ties

White powder-coated aluminium sheet 0.5 mm, one folded blank: front, two sides and top standing 15 mm off the enclosure, open bottom, 30 mm vent slot at the back of the top, 12 mm fixing flanges folded in at the back of each side; four M4 knurled thumb screws into tapped holes in the back plate, so it lifts off without tools
notes: Option, qty 0 in the base node; fit 1 where the site design maximum exceeds 30 C (FND-DDR-002, FND-CAL-001 section C); hot-climate node $148.50

spec: Pluggable terminal block strip (5.08 mm pitch, plug and header, about 12 ways) at the lower edge of the internal plate for the panel lead, both sensor ports and the fixed-cable gland, so the plate lifts out as one unit; two resettable fuses (PTC, about 0.5 A hold), one on each switched sensor rail
